ItemID: NA; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for convenient file transfers alongside my older desktop external drive.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical computer accessories right now and have no clear need for headphones.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Alexa setup, but I recently got an Echo Show 5 and its stand, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa integration and home security interest me, but I would want to establish a need for multiple cameras before choosing this bundle.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Exos X18 16TB Enterprise HDD; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have used external storage, but I have no current need for a large internal enterprise drive.
ItemID: NA; Title: JSAUX Bi-Directional HDMI Switch 4K 60Hz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to switch between my streaming device and Blu-ray player without repeatedly swapping cables.
ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not planning an internal computer upgrade and have not established compatibility with my computer.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1 Foot Short USB C Cord Fast Charge 5 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a clear need for five short USB-C charging cables right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: JOUNIVO USB Microphone JV610; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My webcam already includes a microphone, and I have no current reason to add a separate desktop mic.
